value.text: Material qualities can be thought of as those qualities which are evident when the referent is looked at, weighed, measured, etc. Examples include: `heavy', `blue', `American', `readable', `efficient', `maintainable'. The referents of these qualities are things.
An object quality is quality of an object.

Genuine processes rather than sequences of events. Sequences of state change. Processes are essentially instantaneous and progressive.A processis is built(modeled) in the same manner of functional decomposition. See [Kitamura 2006] in detail.  Essentially open-ended(non-anchored) and time-dependent. By open-ended, I mean neither its beginning nor its termination are sepcified, and hence it is homogeneous(any part of it is the same process). Although it has a time interval to specify in what time region it exists, it has no temporal parts and both ends of the interval are excluded, that is, its interval is an open interval.  Processes are material of events, that is, an event is cnstituted of a process like a vase is constituted of clay.
